Timeline

My name is

Applying for: The Red Lion Solihull

Applying with: Bob Smith, Sarah Smith

Actions Overview

Let's meet and talk

So you've found the right pub for you! It's now time to start completing your profile and for you to meet our team to discuss your future pub business. You should have received some information from our recruitment team telling you more about your chosen pub.

Description Actions Status

Your actions to do

Initial call with Recruitment Thank you for expressing interest in one of our pubs.

Read
Upload

Start to complete your profile Please begin to complete your Profile. Please note all co-applicants will be required to complete their own Profile(s) and will require their own individual email address(es).

Read through initial information Following your discussion with our Recruitment Team, if you have found the right pub for you, we will send you some important pub specific information for you to read before you prepare your business plan.

Read 'A guide to our agreements' We would advise you to read 'A guide to our agreements'.

Initial call with our Divisional Lettings Manager (DLM) Our DLM will call you and explain the next steps.

Prepare for your meeting Write a list of any questions you would like answered at your meeting. This may include questions about the proposed agreement, the premises licence or your training requirements.

Complete meeting with our Divisional Lettings Manager (DLM) or Regional Manager (RM) Meet with our DLM /RM to discuss your chosen pub(s). They will discuss with you your ideas and retail proposition and any property works that might be required.

Upload your Proof of Funding Please upload a copy of your Proof of Funding to the documents section on your profile.

Upload your Personal Licence Please upload a copy of your Personal Licence photo card to the documents section on your profile.

Upload your Right to Work documentation Please upload your Proof of Right to Work to the documents section on your profile.

Complete Pre-Entry Awareness Training We advise you complete Pre Entry Awareness Training (PEAT) and upload your certificate to the documents section on your profile. Add statement that recommended but not compulsory

Read through further information After your meeting, we will send you some additional information to read, including a schedule of condition, before you prepare your business plan.

Read the Pubs Code 2016 We strongly recommend you read the Pubs Code 2016 and understand the obligations of your proposed agreement.

Get independent professional advice You must take independent professional advice including financial, legal, property and rental valuation advice. A list of recommended Solicitors can be found here. For further information on property and rental valuation visit the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors.

Milestones

  • Full facts information issued
  • Schedule 1 Pubs Code 2016 read by Applicant
  • ID, Personal License and Proof of Funding uploaded

Planning your business

You've visited the competitor pubs and have instructed a qualified accountant to work with you on completing your business plan. It's important that both you, and any other named persons on the agreement, complete a profile in addition to confirming your chosen legal business structure.

Description Actions Status

Your actions to do

Instruct a qualified accountant Choose and instruct a qualified Accountant to work with you on your business plan. A list of BII qualified Accountants can be found here.

Inform us of your accountant Once you have informed our DLM/RM of your chosen accountant, we will send you some important information regarding the minimum business plan requirements along with an upload code for your Accountant.

Consider company set up Before you produce your business plan, please consider how the business will be set up, i.e. Sole Trader or a Limited Company. The business plan must be submitted in this / these name(s).

Open business bank accounts and register with HMRC and PAYE It is important to register with HMRC and for PAYE as well as opening a business bank account.

eilearning New modules are now available to you via your training portal.

Prepare your business plan Meet with your Accountant to prepare your business plan, in accordance with your legal business structure.

Read through our property service packs and repair obligations We recommend to read further information on our property service packs and repairing obligations.

Complete profile Please ensure your completed profile is submitted including uploading your Personal Licence, proof of funding, Right to Work and training certificates – please ensure everyone that is going to be named on your agreement has submitted their individual Profiles.

Accountant to upload final business plan Please provide your Accountant with your business plan upload code, this will allow them to upload your final business plan.

Confirm if independent advice taken Please inform our DLM/RM if you have taken independent legal/rental/property advice. If so, please confirm who from.

Read Landlord & Tenant Act 1954 and declaration The agreement you are agreeing to is contracted out of the Landlord & Tenant Act 1954. We will issue you with a simple declaration which details your rights. We strongly recommend that you take independent legal advice. Please note that all parties need to sign this declaration 14 days before completion.

Complete online ordering training module Please complete the eilearning module on How to Order Online.

Milestones

  • Online profile completed
  • Landlord & Tenant Act 1954 read by Applicant
  • Legal structure chosen for new business
  • Business plan submitted & approved

Agreeing terms and advice

It's almost time for you to start your exciting career as a publican. We'll agree a handover day with you; this is when you will sign your agreement. We will do all we can to help you prepare for day one in your pub and ensure that everything is set up for your opening night.

Description Actions Status

Your actions to do

Read through your Pre Contract form Your agreement and associated documents will be issued via email for you to review. It will detail all of your agreed terms and must be signed by all named parties.

Confirm your day of change Your day of change will be confirmed when you sign the Pre-Contract Form (PCF) with our DLM/RM. You will also need to complete your Direct Debit Mandate.

eilearning New modules are now available to you via your training portal. No initial modules mentioned!

Make Pre-Completion Statement funds payment Your Pre-Completion Statement (PCS) will detail the funds required. One of the team will call you to take payment before your completion day.

Place first online order Your DLM/RM will contact you to help you place your first online order. If you have not yet done so, please complete this eilearning module on How to Order Online.

Milestones

  • First online order placed, if not already done so
  • Date of change confirmed and agreement in production
  • Pre-Completion Statement funds payment made

Signing your agreement

It's time to sign your agreement! We look forward to giving you all the support you need to grow and develop your business. Your Regional Manager will be with you every step of the way and will visit you regularly, especially during your first months to make sure you are set up for long-term success.

Description Actions Status

Your actions to do

Sign your agreement Your agreement will be emailed to you seven days before your completion date. The physical copy to sign will be provided on day of change.

eilearning All eilearning modules are now available to you via the training portal.

Welcome to your new pub business! Our DLM / RM will meet you on the completion day to sign the agreement with you. Congratulations and welcome to your new pub business!

Milestones

  • Agreement signed and change completed
  • Free website and BII membership ordered
  • eilearning modules completed
